newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends lower on overseas trend.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends lower on overseas trend.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed lower against the U.S. dollar on Tuesday, reflecting the greenback's strength overseas against the Japanese yen, dealers said.
The local dollar -- which has stayed in lockstep with the U.S. dollar during the greenback's two-year appreciation against the yen -- ended at T$27.582 against Monday's T$27.555 close.
Turnover through dealers was an active US$308 million.
"Although the Taiwan dollar has been relatively strong, it cannot completely ignore the overseas trend," said one dealer at a foreign bank.

She said the local dollar was supported by active foreign funds inflow arising from recent hectic trading in Taiwan's stock market, where market turnover on Tuesday soared to a historic high of T$238.9 billion (US$8.69 billion). The stock index closed 0.67 percent lower.
A T$27.55-60 range was seen for the Taiwan dollar on Wednesday.
